INTRODUCTION 4.1. About IIITD and Request for Proposal Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi (IIIT-Delhi) was created by an Act of Delhi legislature empowering it to carry out R&D, conduct educational programs, and grant degrees. IIIT-Delhi is accelerating on the path to becoming one of the leading compre hensive research-led teaching institutes in India and has proven to be consistently responsive to the evolving needs of society. The faculty members at IIIT -Delhi are among the finest in the country and are internationally recognized. Carrying out cutting -edge research is part of the institutional DNA of IIIT-Delhi. Tenders are invited from eligible, reputed and qualified IT Firms with sound technical and financial capabilities for implementation and maintenance of Computer Based System for conducting Post Graduate Computer Science & Engineering Admission Test (PGCAT-IIITD) on Pan-India Level as per the detailed out in the Scope of Work of this RFP Document. This invitation to bid is open to all Bidders meeting the pre -qualification criteria as mentioned in this RFP Document. 7 5. SCOPE OF THE WORK 5.1. About PGCAT IIITD administers the Post Graduate Computer Science & Engineering Admission Test (PGCAT-IIITD) Entrance examination specifically designed for both GATE and NON -GATE candidates applying for M.Tech. CSE, M.Tech. Research in CSE and PhD CSE. Programs. The PGCAT Exam comprises single segments: a. PGCAT-IIITD Computer-Based Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) Test 5.2. PGCAT-IIITD General Requirements:  The physically secure and located test centres.  High-quality standards for exam centres and their locations.  The platform must be fully functional and available for testing at least one month prior to the examination. The platform should be independently tested by expert(s) from IIITD before the examination date and approved for use.  By deploying technically qualified, experienced, adequate manpower to manage the entire examination process. There should be at least 2 experienced technical persons directly from the agency managing the LAN (Local area network) and 1 experienced person as Centre head at the test center.  A mandatory dry run of their platform at IIIT Delhi at least one day before the exam.  Establishment of a centralized control room at IIIT Delhi on the examination day for real-time monitoring and management of the examination process. The control room shall provide live, center-wise dashboards displaying, at a minimum, the following information: (i) number of students currently logged in at each examination centre, (ii) number of students actively taking the examination at each centre, and (iii) number of students who have completed the examination at each centre.  To obtain connectivity and provide Examination center across the India as per the schemes of different Entrance Examination for different courses as tabulated above and manage them as per requirement.  To develop, host and manage examination web pages for different Entrance Examinations for different courses and other related links.  To address the security issues- Providing security software and securing the network systems to establish a highly secured and sanitized system for the entire process.  Verification of the candidate's identity with the Hall ticket  Invigilation duty in examination hall. 8  Each test centre must have properly maintained and hygienic washroom facilities for both male and female candidates, along with access to safe drinking water.  Identity check with photo ID card (Govt. of India approved) to avoid impersonation.  Signature of the candidate in the attendance sheet.  Ensuring requisite Computer Lab infrastructure including power backup infrastructu re, software, adequate software and Security software for the smooth conduct of the examination  Verification of the signature in the attendance sheet vis-à-vis the signature in the admit card.  To complete the registration process of the candidates before t he start of the examination (digital photo and bio-metric fingerprint capture, etc.) and allow candidates to appear for a test at the Test Centre.  No books, mobile phones etc. will be allowed inside the center.  To conduct Computer -Based MCQ Test in a smoot h and fair manner in a shortest span of time.  To authenticate and evaluate the answer responses of the candidates. 5.2.2. EVALUATION CRITERIA Introduction: The following Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) methodology will be employed to evaluate proposals submitted in response to the tender for providing infrastructure and services for the PAN-INDIA PGCAT exam conducted by IIITD. Evaluation Criteria: 12 A. Technical Proposal (70%):  Proposed Plan for Smooth Exam Conduction: The proposed plan for smooth exam conduction includes a detailed schedule, logistics arrangements, and contingency measures. It also focuses on identifying potential risks and implementing strategies to miti gate them, along with a robust communication plan to coordinate effectively with IIITD and candidates throughout the entire process.  Demonstration of Exam Platform: The demonstration of the exam platform showcases its features, usability, and interactivity , while also assessing its technical stability, including responsiveness and system performance.  Presentation in In -person: The vendor should present a presentation in the IIIT -Delhi campus. Evaluation of the presenter's ability to effectively demonstrate the proposed exam platform and server architecture, showcasing key features and functionalities.  Experience and Expertise: Vendor's track record and experience in conducting similar exams, especially on a PAN-INDIA scale. B. Financial Proposal (30%):  Reasonableness of Cost: Evaluation of the proposed cost vis -à-vis the services and infrastructure offered.  Value for Money: Assessment of the cost -effectiveness of the proposal in delivering the required services.  Transparency and Accountability: Clarity and transparency in the cost breakdown and any additional charges.  The Financial Bid should be valid for a period of not less than 60 days from the date of opening of Bid. 2. EVALUATION PROCESS:  Initial Screening: Ensure that all proposals meet the minimum eligibility criteria outlined in this tender document. Disqualify any proposals that fail to meet these criteria.  Technical Evaluation: A technical evaluation committee will assess the technical proposals based on the predefined evaluation criteria. Each criterion will be scored individually, and the cumulative score will determine the technical merit of each proposal.  Financial Evaluation: The financial proposals of technically qualified bidders will be opened and evaluated after the technical evaluation. The financial proposals will be scored based on the reasonableness of cost, value for money, and transparency.  Composite Score Calculation: The composite score for each proposal will be calculated by combining the weighted scores from the technical and fi nancial evaluations. The weightage for the technical proposal will be 70%, and for the financial proposal, it will be 30%.  Selection: The bidder with the highest composite score will be selected for awarding the contract, subject to meeting all other terms and conditions specified in the document. Important Note: 13  IIITD may conduct negotiations with the selected bidder to finalize the terms of the contract.
